title: 음절표 3: 갸 겨 교 규 줄 읽고 쓰기
objective: Read and say the ㅑ ㅕ ㅛ ㅠ rows (갸 겨 교 규 …) and tell them apart from 가 거 고 구.
summary: Add a short extra stroke to ㅏ ㅓ ㅗ ㅜ to get ㅑ ㅕ ㅛ ㅠ, which add a quick "y" sound.

task.title: Read, build, and write
task.line: Say each syllable or word aloud first, then write your answer.

words.exampleMeaning: I'm going to watch a baseball game.

letters.as: Like "ya" in "yard"; ㅏ with one extra stroke.
Like "yu" in "young"; mouth open, lips not rounded.
Like "you"; lips rounded and pushed forward.

exercises: Complete the chart row with the missing syllable: ① 갸 – 겨 – ____ – 규 ② 냐 – ____ – 뇨 – 뉴 ③ ____ – 려 – 료 – 류
Put the consonant and vowel together into one syllable: ① ㄱ + ㅕ ② ㅁ + ㅛ ③ ㅎ + ㅑ
Choose the syllable that has a "y" sound: ① 고 / 교 ② 무 / 뮤 ③ 서 / 셔
Read each word aloud, then write it in Revised Romanization: ① 휴가 (vacation) ② 뉴스 (news) ③ 소녀 (girl)
answers: ① 교 ② 녀 ③ 랴
① 겨 ② 묘 ③ 햐
① 교 ② 뮤 ③ 셔
① hyuga ② nyuseu ③ sonyeo
